entry.name: tiangong-skywork
entry.description: Skywork is a new AI Office intelligent entity equipped with advanced DeepResearch capabilities. It uses three expert agents and one general agent to conduct deep AI research, generating AI documents, AI PPTs, and AI tables to efficiently handle various office tasks. The AI technology, equipped with the large model, provides an intelligent, efficient, and fast search experience. Not only can it find materials, check information, search for answers, and search for files, but it can also aggregate massive search results intelligently with AI, answering your questions more systematically. The 3.0 large model product has been newly launched, including a trillion-level MOE (Mixture of Experts) model and search enhancement mode. All search services, including AI search and search engine, are available on the open platform.
